title: XGIMI Horizon S Pro projector (model XK03H, device xgimigalileo, MediaTek), Android TV 11 (SDK 30),
header:
XGIMI Horizon S Pro projector (model XK03H, device xgimigalileo, MediaTek), Android TV 11 (SDK 30),
build RT.3.24.329 release-keys.

Apply:   TV_HOST=<projector ip> tools/disable.sh examples/xgimi-horizon-s-pro/debloat.txt
Undo:    TV_HOST=<projector ip> tools/restore.sh examples/xgimi-horizon-s-pro/debloat.txt
Everything is DISABLED, not uninstalled. Comment out any line you want to keep.

Stock launcher: com.google.android.tvlauncher (the only HOME claimant besides Settings' FallbackHome;
setupwraith does not claim HOME on this firmware). Nothing was disabled from the factory.

Launcher notes (applied and verified on a real unit on 2026-10-19, including a reboot):
- The Inputs menu needs `"input_action": "com.xgimi.action.hdmiPlayer"` in the theme (or input_action
in config.xml): XGIMI's HDMI player (com.xgimi.xhplayer/.InputActivity) does not answer the standard
ACTION_VIEW on the passthrough channel URI, so HDMI1 otherwise does nothing.
- No tuner: set `"live_tv_package": ""`. Only HDMI1 is registered, although tvinput has 3 services.
- Projector settings (keystone, focus, picture) stay reachable: Settings pill -> Projector Settings.
- Tailscale does not come back after a reboot by itself. Making it the always-on VPN fixes that:
settings put secure always_on_vpn_app com.tailscale.ipn; settings put secure always_on_vpn_lockdown 0
(takes effect at the next boot). With `"vpn_app": "com.tailscale.ipn"` the network pill shows a red
"VPN off" badge while it is down and opens Tailscale when pressed.
- The default Backdrop screensaver is disabled below; point the screensaver at
com.android.dreams.basic/.Colors (or another dream) or it has nothing to show.

DO NOT DISABLE on XGIMI (projector hardware and inputs):
com.xgimi.autokst                    # auto keystone correction (system uid)
com.xgimi.windowsystem               # keystone/window service (kstActivity, WondowService)
com.xgimi.tof                        # ToF autofocus calibration
com.xgimi.tvinput                    # HDMI 1-3 TV input services
com.xgimi.xhplayer                   # HDMI input player + game mode
com.xgimi.bluetoothservice           # Bluetooth remote service
com.xgimi.misckey                    # remote keys, focus/keystone shortcuts, wall-colour adaptation
com.xgimi.uiconfiguration            # global key receiver, power listener
com.xgimi.xrmservice                 # picture/sound adaptation, brightness boost
com.xgimi.soundermodeservice         # Bluetooth speaker mode
com.xgimi.xgimiservice               # core XGIMI system service
com.xgimi.simpservice                # install service, purpose unclear: kept
com.xgimi.overseas.xgimiatvbootwizard  # first-boot wizard: kept, setup wizards can hold Home or provisioning
